features.name: Free Spins
features.description: 3 or more BONUS symbols award 16 free spins. During free spins, Azteca Gold symbol values accumulate in a pot, which becomes a giant symbol on reels 1-4 for a final respin with potential Azteca Collect trigger.

features.name: Collect Feature
features.context: H2 section 'GAME RULES' and H3 subsections for collect symbol types
features.description: Azteca Collect symbols on reel 5 gather values from Azteca Gold symbols on reels 1-4. Five types include basic Collect, Plus Collect, Multiplier Collect, Expand Collect, and Respin Collect.
characteristics: multiple collector types with different mechanics

features.name: Cash On Reels
features.context: H2 section 'GAME RULES' describing Azteca Gold symbols
features.description: Azteca Gold symbols appear on reels 1-4 and contain random win values that can be collected by Azteca Collect symbols on reel 5.

features.name: Respin
features.description: The Respin Collect symbol holds Azteca Gold symbols in place and triggers a respin, after which all Azteca Gold values are collected and awarded.
characteristics: triggered by specific collect symbol type

specs.description: Azteca Gold Collect is a 5x3 slot with 25 paylines featuring an innovative collect mechanic where Azteca Gold symbols on reels 1-4 display random values that can be gathered by various Azteca Collect symbols on reel 5. The game offers free spins with an accumulating pot system and multiple collect variants including expansion and respins.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Bonus, Azteca Gold, and Azteca Collect

functional_symbols.name: Bonus
functional_symbols.description: Appears on reels 1, 3, and 5; 3+ trigger 16 free spins

functional_symbols.name: Azteca Gold
functional_symbols.description: Contains random win values; appears on reels 1-4; collected by Azteca Collect symbols

functional_symbols.name: Azteca Collect
functional_symbols.description: Five types on reel 5 that collect Azteca Gold values with different mechanics

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Triggered by 4-6 scattered Bonus symbols, awarding 8-12 free spins. Features a global multiplier starting at 1x that increases by +1 for every cascade.

features.name: Hold and Spin
features.description: Triggered by 4+ Hold & Respin scatter symbols. All symbols except scatters are removed, empty positions spin independently with 3 lives that reset when new scatters land.

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.description: Three fixed jackpots linked to bet size: Silver (50x for 4 jackpot symbols), Gold (500x for 5 symbols), and Crypto (5,000x for 6 symbols).

features.name: Cascading Reels
features.context: Free Spins section mentioning multiplier increases for 'every cascade'
features.description: Winning symbols are removed and new symbols cascade down, with multipliers increasing by +1 for each cascade during free spins.

features.name: Megaways
features.description: Uses the Big Time Gaming Megaways mechanic with variable symbols per reel creating changing ways to win.

features.name: Symbol Upgrade
features.description: Can randomly trigger on any spin. An oversized 2x1 upgrade symbol on the bonus reel selects a random symbol to upgrade to a higher value.

features.name: Multiplier
features.context: Free Spins section describing multiplier progression
features.description: During free spins, a global multiplier starts at 1x and increases by +1 for every cascade that occurs.

specs.description: Money Megaways is a Megaways slot featuring cascading reels, symbol upgrades, and a progressive multiplier system. Players can trigger free spins with increasing multipliers, a hold & respin bonus with monetary scatter values, and win one of three fixed jackpots ranging from 50x to 5,000x bet.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Appears on all reels except reel 1, substitutes for all symbols except bonus, hold & respin, jackpot and upgrade symbols

functional_symbols.name: Bonus
functional_symbols.description: Scattered symbol that triggers free spins bonus when 4-6 land anywhere on reels

functional_symbols.name: Hold & Respin
functional_symbols.description: Scatter symbol with monetary values that triggers hold & respin bonus when 4+ appear, carries bet multiplier values

functional_symbols.name: Jackpot
functional_symbols.description: Awards fixed jackpots when 4-6 symbols appear: Silver (50x), Gold (500x), or Crypto (5,000x)

functional_symbols.name: Upgrade
functional_symbols.description: Oversized 2x1 symbol on bonus reel that triggers random symbol upgrade to higher value

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Triggered by Free Spin symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5. Player chooses between 3 options: 10 spins with 2 wild reels, 5 spins with 3 wild reels, or 2 spins with 4 wild reels.
characteristics: Wild reels change positions each spin

features.name: Wild Reels
features.description: Triggers automatically after every tenth spin in base game. Reels with all indicators lit become fully wild for one spin.
characteristics: Progress indicators saved per bet level

features.name: Wheel
features.description: Triggered when wild progress bar reaches certain counts (25, 50, 75, 100, 200). Bonus wheel awards 2-5 spins that are applied to next Wild Reels Feature trigger.
characteristics: Super Bonus at 200 count with 3 wheel spins

features.name: Persistence
features.context: H3 sections 'WILD REELS FEATURE' and 'BONUS GAME'
features.description: Progress indicators accumulate across base game spins to trigger Wild Reels Feature every 10 spins and Bonus Game at milestone counts.

specs.description: Chillilot is a Mexican themed slot with a unique Wild Reels Feature that triggers every tenth spin and a progressive Bonus Game system. Players can choose their free spins volatility and accumulate progress toward bonus wheel spins.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for other symbols during Wild Reels Feature

functional_symbols.name: Free Spin
functional_symbols.description: Appears on reels 1, 3, and 5 to trigger Free Spins Feature
